Terrible App (Website is better). - The app does not update my accounts.  Sometimes it would say it was updated 12 hours ago but would still reflect account balances from 3 days ago

- My [MARCA] account requires too many re-linking.  And everytime it does that, I would see large cash inflow and outflow, causing my net cash flow to be off

- Net worth feature would not show each individual accounts and often would show the total by “cash”, “investment”, “property” only.  I had to go to the website for the details which defeats the purpose of the app

- Overall, this is a decent app if you’re not looking to monitor all your accounts details daily on the go.  Otherwise, just go to their website or link all your accounts to your primary bank/brokerage app which updates your balances faster and more accurately.

If the only way to use this app is to sacrifice privacy under the guise of security, I no longer want anything to do with it.

It’s really unfortunate but I will now have to find another budgeting and financial management app.

sluggish with a UI from the 90s. awful un optimized app

Ruined the app.
